description: Status, block, time, sender, recipient, value, gas used and fee (native and USD) of an EVM transaction, plus the ERC-20 Transfer events inside it (token, symbol, from, to, amount). A pending transaction returns status pending. Read over public RPC; a fallback node is used when the first refuses old receipts. Choose this tool for: Check an EVM transaction's status, fee and token transfers. Close alternatives on this server: btc_tx (Check a Bitcoin transaction's status, fee and size); solana_tx (Check a Solana transaction's status, fee and balance changes). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon
